source_document: Undergraduate Minor Programs - Old Curriculum, Shiv Nadar Institution of Eminence, last updated 7 August 2026 (applicable to students admitted in the 2024 batch and earlier)
coverage_note: Transcribed directly from the University's own PDF circular. Eligibility conditions stated as GPA minimums, specific grades, interviews, or committee decisions are NOT verified by this tool - they are disclosed as-is so a student can check them against their own record. Course-level pre-requisite chains are informational only and are not enforced here, matching how the rest of this app's degree audit already treats pre-requisites.

minors.title: Minor in Economics
minors.school: School of Humanities and Social Sciences
minors.open_to_note: All students in good academic standing; there are no other entry requirements
eligibility_conditions: At least three courses must have codes beginning with 2 or higher.
The GPA calculated from courses counting towards the minor must be at least 5.0 (not verified by this tool).
Courses must be independent of major requirements - a course already counted toward the student's major does not count again here.
From Monsoon 2025, students register for the minor through the Office of Academics.
ECO108 / ECO1009 Logic and Scientific Methods, Swayam courses, and certain advanced electives not open as University-Wide Electives do not count toward the minor.
